data.action: 坐在床边，持诊断平板检查手腕。
data.description: 成年凯尔希坐在私人舱室床边，黑色长袍松开，一手拿诊断平板，另一手检查手腕；闭合的舱门上落着抽象的 Mon3tr 轮廓影。
data.lighting: 暖阅读灯从左上照到腕带与丝袍，圆舷窗给舱门上抽象的影子一点冷光
data.nsfwProse: Her loosely belted black silk cabin robe parts open down the front to bare her breasts and pale legs as she sits barefoot at the bed edge.
data.promptProse: Kal'tsit sits upright at the corner of her Rhodes Island cabin bed in her loosely belted black silk robe with its front open. The diagnostic tablet rests against the mattress beside her. With her left forearm supported across her lap, she turns the wrist so she can press the sensor clasp with the fingers of her right hand. A warm reading lamp lights the edge of her hair and the silver band. Beyond her, cold light from the round porthole defines an abstract Mon3tr shadow over the shut slate-gray cabin door. Frame her from an oblique angle across the bed, including her full face and the hands at her lap.
data.title: 凯尔希 · 舱室灯下的腕部复查
data.animaCaption: Seated barefoot at the cabin bed edge with her black silk robe parted open across her bare chest, Kal'tsit lifts her wrist from her lap and presses the silver sensor clasp with two fingertips. Warm reading lamplight illuminates her face and the tablet beside her while cold porthole light casts an abstract Mon3tr shadow over the shut door.
